inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A piece of a pixel art battle stage background at its own pixel size: a night sky with a big pale moon and stars over a red cliff city of tombs, a market stall with caged mummified animals between two hooded statues. In it: four ember bats and three bone birds in the sky and two traders at the stall, small, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around them. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background.
